verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers AvaTax's tax calculation, transaction recording, nexus tracking, and MCP/API capabilities — none of it describes an in-product service where Avalara files state/local sales tax permit registrations on the customer's behalf with per-registration pricing or status tracking. The nexus API merely tracks declared nexus, it does not file registrations. Community evidence (avalara-comm-1) explicitly notes that per-jurisdiction tax registration and filing remains separate work even when using tools like Avalara, reinforcing that this capability is not delivered in-product.
